title: Tulsi Gabbard mentions UAPs in her DNI confirmation testimony
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Tulsi Gabbard mentions UAPs in her DNI confirmation testimony, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Like um you have Tulsi Gabbard uh at DNI who's apparently, you know, pretty pro Bitcoin and and and also now I think in her testimony was talking about sort of UAPs explicitly in in her in her.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines says that in 2025 Tulsi Gabbard, chosen as Director of National Intelligence (the official who oversees all US spy agencies), spoke openly about UAPs, the government's term for UFOs, during her testimony before the US Senate. Pines also describes her as fairly friendly toward Bitcoin. He brings it up as a sign that the subject is being taken seriously at the very top of US intelligence.
